"'''Underburn'''" was the nickname for the underworld section of the [[Burnout (space station)|''Burnout'']] space station operated by the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]]. "Underburn" was home to an illegal slaving arena.
